focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业需完成碳排放数据申报准备
focus.summary: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征收阶段。届时钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力及氢能等六大行业出口至欧盟的货物须申报隐含碳排放并购买相应证书。中国出口企业应尽快建立产品级碳排放核算体系，收集上游供应链数据，并评估在欧盟注册申报义务。未及时合规可能导致货物滞留或额外成本。建议企业提前与欧盟进口商对接，明确数据共享与责任分配。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会气候行动总司 · 2026.09.23
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Must Prepare for Carbon Data Reporting
focus.summary_en: The EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period ends in late 2026, with the definitive regime starting in 2027. Exporters of iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity and hydrogen to the EU will need to report embedded emissions and purchase certificates. Chinese exporters should establish product-level carbon accounting, collect upstream supply chain data, and assess EU registration obligations. Non-compliance may lead to shipment delays or extra costs. Early engagement with EU importers on data sharing and responsibility allocation is strongly advised.

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭承认与执行中国法院商事判决，明确互惠关系认定标准
case.summary: 近期新加坡国际商事法庭（SICC）在一宗跨境贸易合同纠纷中，依据《新加坡国际商事法庭法》承认与执行中国法院作出的商事判决。法院重点审查了中新建交及司法互惠关系，认为中国法院此前承认新加坡判决的记录构成互惠基础。该案为中国企业在新加坡申请执行中国判决提供了路径参考。实务中需注意判决终局性、程序正当性及公共政策审查。建议企业在合同中约定争议解决条款时，评估判决跨境执行可行性。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭 · 2026年第三季度
case.title_en: Singapore International Commercial Court Recognises and Enforces Chinese Commercial Judgment, Clarifying Reciprocity Test
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC) recently recognised and enforced a Chinese commercial judgment in a cross-border trade contract dispute under the SICC Act. The court examined the judicial reciprocity between China and Singapore, finding that prior Chinese recognition of Singaporean judgments established a reciprocal basis. This case offers a reference for Chinese enterprises seeking enforcement of Chinese judgments in Singapore. Practitioners should note finality, due process, and public policy review. When drafting dispute resolution clauses, parties should assess cross-border enforceability.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Commercial Court · Q3 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境商事纠纷一站式解决平台，整合调解仲裁诉讼服务
policy.summary: 粤港澳大湾区近期推出跨境商事纠纷一站式解决平台，整合粤港澳三地调解、仲裁与诉讼资源，为区内企业提供在线立案、跨境送达、法律查明及多元解纷服务。平台依托前海、南沙、横琴等合作区，探索“港资港法港仲裁”与“澳资澳法澳仲裁”适用范围扩展。企业可借此降低跨境维权成本，缩短解纷周期。建议出海企业熟悉平台规则，在合同中灵活设计争议解决条款，并利用在线调解前置程序化解小额纠纷。
policy.source: 来源：粤港澳大湾区法律部门联席会议 · 2026.09
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Launches One-Stop Cross-Border Commercial Dispute Resolution Platform
policy.summary_en: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area has launched a one-stop cross-border commercial dispute resolution platform, integrating mediation, arbitration and litigation resources across the three jurisdictions. It offers online case filing, cross-border service, legal ascertainment and multi-tiered dispute resolution. Leveraging Qianhai, Nansha and Hengqin cooperation zones, the platform explores extending the application of Hong Kong and Macao law and arbitration. Enterprises can reduce cross-border enforcement costs and shorten resolution cycles. Businesses should familiarise themselves with platform rules and design flexible dispute resolution clauses.
policy.source_en: Source: GBA Legal Departments Joint Conference · 2026.09

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围，中国科技企业需重构跨境股权与数据合规架构
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国近期拟进一步扩大对外投资安全审查范围，将半导体、人工智能、量子计算等敏感领域的境外投资纳入申报或禁止范畴。中国科技企业通过离岸架构进行海外融资、并购或技术合作时，可能触发美方管辖。建议企业立即梳理现有跨境股权与控制关系，评估被认定为“受关注外国实体”的风险；在交易文件中加入合规陈述与保证、政府审批风险分配条款；并建立数据出境与知识产权隔离机制。必要时可调整投资路径，采用合资或许可模式降低直接持股敏感度。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · iGlobal Law 研究部 · 2026.09.23
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Expanded US Outbound Investment Screening Requires Chinese Tech Firms to Restructure Cross-Border Equity and Data Compliance
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US is poised to further expand its outbound investment security screening, bringing foreign investments in semiconductors, AI and quantum computing within notification or prohibition scope. Chinese tech firms using offshore structures for financing, M&A or tech cooperation may trigger US jurisdiction. Companies should immediately map existing cross-border equity and control relationships, assess risks of being deemed a 'foreign entity of concern', include compliance representations and government approval risk allocation in transaction documents, and establish data export and IP segregation mechanisms. Where necessary, adjust investment paths via JVs or licensing to reduce direct equity sensitivity.
